definitions.explanation: An attitude of not caring about the outcome, doing things carelessly without effort or responsibility. Implies giving up on trying properly.

examples.japanese: {投|な}げやりな{態度|たいど}はよくない。
{疲|つか}れて{何|なに}もかも{投|な}げやりになってしまった。
examples.english: I got tired and became apathetic about everything.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}がうまくいかなくて{投|な}げやりな{気持|きも}ちになったが、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}に{励|はげ}まされた。
examples.english: When work wasn't going well I felt like giving up, but the people around me encouraged me.

notes:
{投|な}げやり describes an irresponsible, couldn't-care-less attitude. It comes from the image of throwing something away carelessly ({投|な}げる + やる).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {投|な}げやりな + noun: a half-hearted ~
- {投|な}げやりになる: to become apathetic, to stop caring

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投|な}げやりな{態度|たいど}: a careless / couldn't-care-less attitude
- {投|な}げやりな{返事|へんじ}: an indifferent reply
- {投|な}げやりな{言|い}い{方|かた}: a dismissive way of speaking
- {投|な}げやりな{気持|きも}ち: a feeling of apathy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いい{加減|かげん}: irresponsible, sloppy (broader range of carelessness)
- {無責任|むせきにん}: irresponsible (more formal, focuses on lack of responsibility)
- やる{気|き}がない: unmotivated, lacking motivation
